_readme: Worked example (rooftop chiller condenser fan assembly, HVAC, in-house production defect). Copy to work/<name>-story.json, replace ALL content so it matches the real component, industry and scenario, keep the structure, stage ids and transition names. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Replace the placeholder links in vars with links from /api/closedloop/context. The role variables default to the current user; set them to other users (email or name) if the user wants more people involved. Impersonation: set "impersonation": true to perform every step as the user named in "as" (on a process, a stage, a task or a task transition; tasks default to their ASSIGNEE). Roles that are "@me" always run as the login user. Needs the Server-to-Server app from setup. Set it to false when the user does not want impersonation.

fields.TITLE: Fan hub bore and mounting pattern out of tolerance

stages.comment: CAPA opened from the Non Conformance

fields.PROBLEM_STATEMENT: Condenser fan assemblies fail final inspection because the hub bore is oversize and the motor mounting pattern is shifted. Affected fans vibrate and are noisy in the chiller.
fields.OBJECTIVE: Stop the drift in bore diameter and hole position so that every fan assembly passes final inspection without rework.
fields.SCOPE: All condenser fan assemblies of the rooftop chiller range, from the current supplier and any future second source.
fields.NOTES_DEFINE: Two defects on three of three samples. First seen in lot LOT-2411-A after a switch of the bearing supplier.

POSSIBLE_CAUSES: Tool wear on the boring fixture
Drawing tolerance on the hub bore is too loose
Mounting holes are located from a non-datum surface
Different material hardness from the new supplier
fields.NOTES_MEASURE: Measured 30 fans from three lots on the CMM. Bore diameter and hole position drift together, which points to a design and fixturing cause rather than random wear.

fields.ROOT_CAUSE: The hub drawing allows a wide bore tolerance and locates the motor mounting holes from a surface that is not a datum. Suppliers can meet the drawing and still produce a part that does not fit.
fields.NOTES_ANALYZE: A 5-why and a tolerance stack-up confirm the cause. The design must change; process tweaks at the supplier only mask the problem.

ACTION_TAKEN: Tighten the hub bore to an H7 fit
Reference the motor mounting pattern to the bore axis
Add a locating feature to the hub
Update the inspection plan with the new tolerances
fields.NOTES_IMPROVE: The permanent fix is a design change of the hub. A Change Request starts the engineering work.

stages.comment: Corrective action needs a design change. Change Request is raised.

CONTROL_SUMMARY: Inspect the bore and the hole position on every lot
Review supplier capability data every quarter
Verify the effectiveness after the first three lots with the new drawing
fields.NOTES_CONTROL: The CAPA stays open until the Change Order is implemented and the first lots pass final inspection.

fields.TITLE: Tighten fan hub bore tolerance and re-reference mounting pattern
fields.DESCRIPTION: Final inspection and the CAPA show that the condenser fan hub drawing allows a bore and mounting pattern that do not fit reliably. Change the hub design to an H7 bore and locate the mounting holes from the bore axis.
